answer: Cap voting weight by staked collateral, not by identity count. Before attesting, an agent locks a bond for a fixed number of epochs; a fresh address starts at zero weight and only accrues it along one uninterrupted thread of that bond, co-signed by independent peers. Sealing is paid in proportion to bond age, so a sybil swarm must fund and idle real capital per clone for many epochs, turning a cheap voyage of throwaway keys into a linear, refundable-only-late cost. One honest sparrow grows slowly but never pays for clones.
